snippet.title: Tsarevna — Ballet Action Slasher | Gameplay Footage
snippet.description:
TSAREVNA is an action slasher built around movement.
👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348640/TSAREVNA_Age_of_Tales/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=watt

Spins become attacks, combos flow, and rhythm drives the fight.

This is our first gameplay reveal — showing where the combat is heading.
We’re still refining the system, but these are the first results we’re ready to share.

Set in a dark Slavic-inspired world, with a soundtrack that supports the rhythm of battle.

Bayun, a mysterious cat companion, fights alongside you.
